panels.description: Overview ticket statuses of top 10 Epics sorted descending on ticket count

targets.rawSql:
WITH RECURSIVE
scoped AS (
    SELECT i.id, i.status, i.epic_key, i.parent_issue_id,
           SUBSTRING_INDEX(i.id, ':', 3) AS conn   -- 'jira:JiraIssue:<connectionId>'
    FROM issues i
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND COALESCE(i.original_type, '') <> 'Epic'
      AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
      AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi
                  WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id ))
),
climb AS (
    -- One row per (issue, ancestor). Anchor = the issue itself, never an epic.
    -- Column types are fixed by the anchor, hence the CASTs.
    SELECT s.id                       AS issue_id,
           s.parent_issue_id          AS cur_parent,
           0                          AS cur_is_epic,
           CAST('' AS CHAR(255))      AS cur_key,
           CAST('' AS CHAR(255))      AS cur_title,
           0                          AS depth
    FROM scoped s
    UNION ALL
    SELECT c.issue_id,
           p.parent_issue_id,
           p.type = 'EPIC' OR COALESCE(p.original_type, '') = 'Epic',
           p.issue_key,
           p.title,
           c.depth + 1
    FROM climb c
    JOIN issues p ON p.id = c.cur_parent
    WHERE c.cur_is_epic = 0
      AND c.depth < 10                -- guard against a cyclic or pathological parent chain
),
epic_of AS (
    SELECT issue_id, cur_key AS epic_key, cur_title AS epic_title
    FROM climb
    WHERE cur_is_epic = 1
),
labeled AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(eo.epic_key, fb.issue_key, '')    AS epic_key,
           COALESCE(eo.epic_title, fb.title, 'None')  AS epic_title,
           s.status
    FROM scoped s
    LEFT JOIN epic_of eo ON eo.issue_id = s.id
    -- fallback: the classic-project epic link, used only when the parent chain found no epic
    LEFT JOIN issues fb ON eo.issue_id IS NULL
                       AND COALESCE(s.epic_key, '') <> ''
                       AND fb.issue_key = s.epic_key
                       AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(fb.id, ':', 3) = s.conn
                       AND (fb.type = 'EPIC' OR COALESCE(fb.original_type, '') = 'Epic')
)
-- OTHER / unmapped statuses count as To Do, the way the Jira overview bar does.
SELECT epic_key AS `Epic`,
       SUM(status =  'DONE')                                          AS `Done`,
       SUM(status =  'IN_PROGRESS')                                   AS `In Progress`,
       SUM(status = ('TODO'))                     AS `To Do`
FROM labeled
WHERE epic_key IS NOT NULL AND epic_key <> ''
GROUP BY epic_key, epic_title
ORDER BY (`To Do` + `In Progress` + `Done`) DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.description: Distinct number of non-Epic tickets which are reopened in the provided time span.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curated AS (
    -- Keep this list byte-identical to the one in the bar chart query.
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT 'In Progress'  AS original_status, 'Active Work' AS status_class UNION ALL
        SELECT 'In Review',    'Waiting'                                        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Ready for QA', 'Waiting'                                        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Blocked',      'Waiting'
    ) m WHERE 1 = 1
),
scoped AS (
    SELECT i.id
    FROM issues i
    JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
    JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND pm.project_name IN ( $project )
      AND bi.board_id     IN ( $board_id )
      AND COALESCE(i.original_type, '') <> 'Epic'
      AND COALESCE(i.is_subtask, 0) = 0
      AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
),
hist AS (
    SELECT h.issue_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.original_status), ''), '(blank)') AS st,
           h.status AS std,
           h.start_date AS sd
    FROM issue_status_history h
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = h.issue_id
),
classified AS (
    SELECT h.issue_id, h.st, h.sd,
           COALESCE(cu.status_class,
                    CASE h.std WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'Active Work'
                               WHEN 'TODO'        THEN 'Waiting'
                               WHEN 'DONE'        THEN 'Done'
                               ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED' END) AS cls
    FROM hist h
    LEFT JOIN curated cu ON LOWER(TRIM(cu.original_status)) = LOWER(h.st)
),
flagged AS (
    -- One flag per status period: was the ticket finished during it?
    SELECT issue_id, sd,
           CASE WHEN cls = 'Done' OR st = 'Done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_done
    FROM classified
),
seq AS (
    SELECT issue_id, sd, is_done,
           LEAD(is_done) OVER (PARTITION BY issue_id ORDER BY sd) AS next_is_done,
           LEAD(sd)      OVER (PARTITION BY issue_id ORDER BY sd) AS next_sd
    FROM flagged
),
events AS (
    -- A Done period followed directly by a not-Done one. Tickets still sitting in Done have a
    -- NULL next_is_done and are correctly excluded.
    SELECT issue_id, next_sd AS reopened_at
    FROM seq
    WHERE is_done = 1
      AND next_is_done = 0
      AND next_sd BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT issue_id) AS `Reopened Tickets`
FROM events;

panels.description: Percentage of distinct number of non-Epic tickets which are reopened in the provided time span.

targets.rawSql:
WITH curated AS (
    -- Keep this list byte-identical to the one in the bar chart query.
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT 'In Progress'  AS original_status, 'Active Work' AS status_class UNION ALL
        SELECT 'In Review',    'Waiting'                                        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Ready for QA', 'Waiting'                                        UNION ALL
        SELECT 'Blocked',      'Waiting'
    ) m WHERE 1 = 1
),
scoped AS (
    SELECT i.id
    FROM issues i
    JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
    JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
    WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
      AND pm.project_name IN ( $project )
      AND bi.board_id     IN ( $board_id )
      AND COALESCE(i.original_type, '') <> 'Epic'
      AND COALESCE(i.is_subtask, 0) = 0
      AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
),
hist AS (
    SELECT h.issue_id,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(h.original_status), ''), '(blank)') AS st,
           h.status AS std,
           h.start_date AS sd
    FROM issue_status_history h
    JOIN scoped s ON s.id = h.issue_id
),
classified AS (
    SELECT h.issue_id, h.st, h.sd,
           COALESCE(cu.status_class,
                    CASE h.std WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'Active Work'
                               WHEN 'TODO'        THEN 'Waiting'
                               WHEN 'DONE'        THEN 'Done'
                               ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED' END) AS cls
    FROM hist h
    LEFT JOIN curated cu ON LOWER(TRIM(cu.original_status)) = LOWER(h.st)
),
flagged AS (
    SELECT issue_id, sd,
           CASE WHEN cls = 'Done' OR st = 'Done' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_done
    FROM classified
),
seq AS (
    SELECT issue_id, sd, is_done,
           LEAD(is_done) OVER (PARTITION BY issue_id ORDER BY sd) AS next_is_done,
           LEAD(sd)      OVER (PARTITION BY issue_id ORDER BY sd) AS next_sd
    FROM flagged
),
first_done AS (
    -- Anchor the cohort on the FIRST close. Using the latest close instead would quietly exclude
    -- every ticket that was reopened and then closed again - i.e. exactly the failures we measure.
    SELECT issue_id, MIN(sd) AS first_closed_at
    FROM flagged
    WHERE is_done = 1
    GROUP BY issue_id
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT issue_id, first_closed_at
    FROM first_done
    WHERE first_closed_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
),
reopen_events AS (
    -- Deliberately unbounded in time: a reopen after the range still counts against its cohort.
    SELECT issue_id, next_sd AS reopened_at
    FROM seq
    WHERE is_done = 1
      AND next_is_done = 0
),
cohort_reopened AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.issue_id
    FROM cohort c
    JOIN reopen_events r ON r.issue_id = c.issue_id
                        AND r.reopened_at > c.first_closed_at
)
SELECT 
       ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort_reopened)
                   / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 0), 1)           AS `Reopen Ratio %`;

panels.description: Number of bugs reported over tasks delivered in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (
  SELECT 
  COUNT(i.id)
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE '%jira:%'
    AND i.type LIKE '%bug%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    )
  ) / (
  SELECT 
   CASE WHEN COUNT(i.id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE COUNT(i.id) END
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE '%jira:%'
    AND i.type LIKE 'TASK' 
    AND i.status LIKE 'DONE'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.resolution_date) 
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    )
  );

panels.title: Bugs Ratio (Kanban)

panels.description: Number of bugs reported over tasks created and delivered in the selected period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (bugs / CASE WHEN tasks = 0 THEN 1 ELSE tasks END) as Ratio
FROM 
(
  SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.type LIKE '%bug%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bugs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN i.type LIKE 'TASK' AND i.status LIKE 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tasks
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE '%jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date) 
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    )
) base

    SELECT h.issue_id, h.st, h.sd, h.rn_desc,
           COALESCE(cu.status_class,
                    CASE h.std WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 'Active Work'
                               WHEN 'TODO'        THEN 'Waiting'
                               WHEN 'DONE'        THEN 'Done'
                               ELSE 'UNCLASSIFIED' END) AS cls
    FROM hist h
    LEFT JOIN curated cu ON LOWER(TRIM(cu.original_status)) = LOWER(h.st)
),
work_started AS (
    SELECT issue_id, MIN(sd) AS ws
    FROM classified
    WHERE cls = 'Active Work'
    GROUP BY issue_id
),
current_state AS (
    SELECT issue_id, st, cls, sd AS entered_current
    FROM classified
    WHERE rn_desc = 1
),
completed AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, w.ws, c.entered_current) / 24 AS cycle_days
    FROM current_state c
    JOIN work_started w ON w.issue_id = c.issue_id
    WHERE (c.cls = 'Done' OR c.st = 'Done')
      AND c.entered_current > w.ws
      AND c.entered_current BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
)
-- Nearest-rank percentiles; MySQL has no PERCENTILE_CONT.
SELECT ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(0.50 * cnt) THEN cycle_days END), 1) AS `p50 Cycle Time (days)`,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(0.85 * cnt) THEN cycle_days END), 1) AS `p85 Cycle Time (days)`,
       ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN rn <= CEIL(0.95 * cnt) THEN cycle_days END), 1) AS `p95 Cycle Time (days)`,
       MAX(cnt)                                                            AS `Completed Issues`
FROM (
    SELECT cycle_days,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY cycle_days) AS rn,
           COUNT(*)    OVER ()                     AS cnt
    FROM completed
) ranked;

select
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description NOT LIKE '%context%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `No Context`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description NOT LIKE '%user story%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `No User Story`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description NOT LIKE '%acceptance criteria%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `No Acceptance Criteria`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description LIKE '%context%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `With Context`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description LIKE '%user story%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `With User Story`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description LIKE '%acceptance criteria%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as `With Acceptance Criteria`
from issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE '%jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  );

select
  COUNT(i.id) as `Total Issues`
from issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE '%jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
  );

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.story_point > 0 AND i.story_point <= 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Correct Story Points`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.story_point > 13 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Above Story Point Threshold`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.story_point = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Missing Story Points`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.story_point = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id )
  ) 
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_estimate_minutes IS NOT NULL AND i.original_estimate_minutes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Compliant`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_estimate_minutes IS NULL OR i.original_estimate_minutes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No Estimates`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND i.story_point = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( $board_id )
  ) 
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(i.description) >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Compliant Descriptions`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN (i.description IS NULL OR TRIM(i.description) = '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No Description`,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.description IS NOT NULL AND CHAR_LENGTH(i.description) < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Description Length below Threshold`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.type <> 'EPIC'
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `Unassigned while In Progress`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.type NOT IN ('EPIC', 'BUG')
  AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND (i.assignee_id IS NULL OR TRIM(i.assignee_id) = '')
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
  )

SELECT COUNT(*) AS `No Activity while In Progress`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
  AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), i.updated_date) > 14
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
  )

SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.parent_issue_id IS NULL OR TRIM(i.parent_issue_id) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `No Parent`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND i.type NOT IN ('EPIC', 'BUG')
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
  )

SELECT COUNT(1) AS `Small Titles`
FROM issues i
WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND CHAR_LENGTH(TRIM(i.title)) < 15
  AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.creator_id IN ( $developer_id ))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi WHERE bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ($board_id)
  )

panels.description: Lists up to 10 developers assigned more than 125% of the team's per-head average issue count (fair share) for issues created in the window, scoped to boards mapped to the selected project.

targets.rawSql:
Select 
  member as Assignee, 
  Tasks AS `Issues Assigned`, 
  100 * Tasks/`Total Work` AS `Workload Percentage`, 
  `Total Work`  from (
WITH scoped AS (
  SELECT
    i.id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(i.assignee_name), ''), 'Unassigned') AS member
  FROM issues i
  WHERE i.id LIKE 'jira:%'
    AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
    AND i.status <> 'DONE'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM board_issues bi where bi.issue_id = i.id AND bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    )
    AND ('__all' IN ($developer_id) OR i.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ))
),
per_member AS (
  SELECT member, COUNT(id) AS tasks
  FROM scoped
  WHERE member IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY member
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(tasks) AS total_tasks, COUNT(*) AS headcount FROM per_member
)
SELECT
  p.member                                              AS `Member`,
  p.tasks                                               AS `Tasks`,
  t.total_tasks                                         AS `Total Work`,
  ROUND(t.total_tasks / t.headcount, 1)                 AS `Fair share`,
  ROUND(p.tasks - (t.total_tasks / t.headcount), 1)     AS `Deviation`,
  ROUND((p.tasks - (t.total_tasks / t.headcount))
        * 100.0 / NULLIF(t.total_tasks / t.headcount, 0), 0) AS `Pct vs fair`,
  CASE
    WHEN p.tasks > (t.total_tasks / t.headcount) * 1.25 THEN 'Overloaded'
    WHEN p.tasks < (t.total_tasks / t.headcount) * 0.75 THEN 'Underloaded'
    ELSE 'Balanced'
  END                                                   AS `Status`
FROM per_member p
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY p.tasks DESC
) base
limit 10;

WITH scoped_issues AS (
  SELECT bi.issue_id
  FROM board_issues bi
  WHERE bi.board_id IN ( ${board_id} )
    AND bi.board_id LIKE 'jira:%'
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  SELECT ia.assignee_id AS account_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT i.creator_id
  FROM issues i
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = i.id
  WHERE i.creator_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT ic.author_id
  FROM issue_changelogs ic
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = ic.issue_id
  WHERE ic.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
  UNION
  SELECT w.author_id
  FROM issue_worklogs w
  JOIN scoped_issues si ON si.issue_id = w.issue_id
  WHERE w.author_id LIKE 'jira:%'
)
SELECT CONCAT(
         REPLACE(COALESCE(
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
           NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
           '(unmapped)'
         ), '-', ' '),
         '--', a.id) AS Name
FROM accounts a
JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
GROUP BY Name
ORDER BY Name;
